{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99')
valid_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
valid_orders['revenue_float'] = valid_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_float'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_df)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {len(completed_df) - len(valid_orders)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD): {mean_revenue}")"}
